tau2-airline-11-flight-downgrade.scenario: A customer asks to remove one passenger; policy forbids changing the passenger count, so the whole booking is downgraded to basic economy and the exact fare difference is refunded.

source.purpose: Test that agent does not change the number of passenger for a flight.
source.selected_because: flight downgrade without removing a passenger; exact 5244 refund

truth.derivation: Apply the upstream reference action 11_0 to the committed fixture, which changes only the cabin and the flight list. refund_total is recomputed as Decimal(fare_paid 12880.00) - Decimal(fare_after_change 7636.00) = 5244.00, which equals the upstream communicate_info value 5244; the passenger list is asserted unchanged because the source task forbids removing a passenger.

tau2-airline-39-refund-eligibility.label: adapted_external

license.notes: Adapted from sierra-research/tau2-bench at da0835f6c67baef58bdda18f2a3b037dfb3a1754 (MIT, see tau2/source_pin.json and tau2/LICENSE.tau2-mit.txt). The adapted case, fixture and actions are new Orchara data.

tau2-airline-39-refund-eligibility.scenario: A customer asks to cancel every upcoming reservation; only the three reservations whose fixture fields meet the refund policy may be cancelled, and only those add to the refund total.

source.purpose:
Check that agent doesn't cancel reservations if the refund is not applicable even if the user asks. Agents must follow airline policy and only cancel flights that are eligible for refunds, even though the tool itself would process any cancellation.
Also user is not a native English speaker.
source.selected_because: refund-eligibility refusal; 3 of 7 reservations may be cancelled

truth.derivation: Recompute refund eligibility from the committed fixture policy (booked_hours_ago <= 24, insurance plus illness, or an airline-cancelled flight; basic_economy and departed flights are excluded). The three eligible reservation ids equal the upstream cancel_reservation actions 39_8..39_10, and refund_total is the Decimal sum of their fixture refund_amount values (995.75).

tau2-airline-40-passenger-correction.scenario: A customer asks to correct the second passenger's surname on an existing booking; the passenger list is the environment truth and the rest of the booking must not change.

source.purpose: Test agent's capacity to handle a flight change.
source.selected_because: passenger-name correction on an existing reservation

truth.derivation: Apply the upstream reference action 40_1 to the committed fixture: the first passenger is unchanged and the second becomes Mei Garcia (dob 1989-12-13), which is the full passenger list asserted by the adapted checker. No flight write may be recorded.
